title: One profile's recommendation lists (the value the importer stores per profile)
description: The `payload` column of the `profiles` table, UTF-8 JSON. Stored as one key-value value (Cloudflare) or one row (SQLite, PostgreSQL) per profile, so browse reads it in one round trip. services/recs/README.md, Artefacts.

v.description: Payload format major version (same as the manifest's formatVersion).

profile.description: Pseudonymous profile key (also the row key).

run.description: The run (model version) that produced these lists.

expiresAt.description: After this instant the engine treats the lists as stale and falls back to the milestone 1 rules.

type.description: personal: every candidate by model score (no diversification), for ordering any row; top-picks: diversified list for a dedicated row; billboard: unstarted candidates for the billboard; because-you-watched: personalised neighbours of `param`. Unknown types must be ignored (additive minor versions).

param.description: Row parameter: the source title id for because-you-watched; null otherwise.

items.description: Best first: [titleId, score]. Scores are comparable only within one row of one payload; higher is better.
